verses.text: Hex ix, b'ak'ech hex yuj he b'eyumal icha nok' wakax t'a Basán, hex kajan hex t'a tzalan yik chonhab' Samaria, ab'ek wal jun tik: Tzeyixtej heb' meb'a' yet' heb' ilb'ajk'o'ol yilji, tzeyalan t'a heb' winh heyetb'eyum: Ik'ekkot anh anh to skuk'ej anh, xe chi.

Ha Jehová haton Yajal yaji, ix slok sb'i ix yak'an sti', ix yalani: Ol k'och sk'uhal, ol ak'chajoch gancho t'ayex, ol hex nherchajb'eyok, haxo heb' heyune', ol och lokan anzuelo t'a heb', ol jachchajb'at heb'.
Ha hin Jehová hin swala', tzololixonhej ol aj heyik'chajel b'aj ol mak'chaj poj pat chi', ol hex ik'chajpaxb'at t'a najat.
Ixikek t'a Betel yet' t'a Gilgal, tzeyak'anoch he mul icha he gana ta'. Slajwi chi' tzeyak'an heyofrenda t'a junjun k'inhib'alil, t'a schab'ji'al tzeyak'anpax he diezmo.
nhusek ixim pan ay yich t'a ofrenda'il yuj he ak'oj yuj diosal. Alekel t'a skal anima yuj jantak heyofrenda tz'el t'a he k'o'ol heyak'ani, yujto icha chi' he gana tze k'ulej.
Yuj chi', ix wak' heyab' sya'il wejel t'a masanil yol he chonhab' tik, palta manh yujok chi' ix hex meltzajkot t'ayin.

Ix wak'anoch wa'an nhab' t'a oxe' ujal ayik manto elul sat heyawb'en. Ix yak' nhab' t'a jun chonhab', haxo t'a junxo, ma'ay. Ay b'aj ix yak' nhab' chi', ay b'aj ma'ay, yuj chi' ix takji'el masanil heyawb'en.
Chab' oxe' chonhab'il hex ix hex b'at sayoj ha' t'a junokxo chonhab', palta maj yab'laj ha' yik tz'ek' stak'inhal he ti'. Tokwal yuj chi' ix hex meltzajkot t'ayin.

Ix wak' heyahelal yet' ik' te k'ak' yet' juntzanhxo yahelal, ix wak'an ixtax tas tzeyawej yet' heyuwa. Haxo nok' k'ulub' ix k'uxanb'at te' heyigo yet' te' heyolivo. Tokwal yuj chi' ix hex meltzajkot t'ayin.

Ix wak'kot juntzanh yahelal t'a heyib'anh, icha wal ix aj wak'anb'at yahelal t'a Egipto. Ix cham heb' he kelemtak t'a skal owal, haxo heb' heyajk'o'ol chi' ix ikankan nok' he chej, ix heyab'an sjab' chamnak ayek' t'a he campamento. Tokwal yuj chi' ix hex meltzajkot t'ayin.

Ix hex wak' lajwokem icha ix aj wak'an lajwokem chonhab' Sodoma yet' Gomorra, yuj chi' ha hex ixto hex kan tik, icha junok kuxk'ak' tz'ik'chajkanelta t'a yol k'ak', icha wal chi' heyaji. Tokwal yuj chi' ix hex meltzajkot t'ayin.
Icha chi' ol hex wutej hex aj Israel. Yuj chi' b'o'ek he b'a, yujto ol heyil-laj och he sat wet'ok ha hin he Diosal hin tik.

Ha hin Jehová hin, ix hin b'o niwak witz yet' ik', swak'an yojtakejel heb' anima tas nab'il wu'uj. Ha hin swak' meltzajoch sakil k'inal t'a k'ik'alk'inalil, cha'anh tzin b'eyek' t'a yib'anh lum lum. Ha hin b'i, haton Jehová Dios, Yajal hin t'a Smasanil, xchi Jehová chi'.
